## Functional summary

This 485-aa protein is very likely a bacterial **ThiI tRNA sulfurtransferase**. Its closest reviewed match is ThiI from *Ectopseudomonas mendocina* (UniProt A4XZX0), with **81% sequence identity and 100% coverage** (E-value 1.12 × 10⁻²⁸⁴). This strongly supports the functional assignment, although the query protein itself was not experimentally characterized in this analysis.

Reviewed ThiI homologs are annotated to use ATP in sulfur transfer for two functions: formation of **4-thiouridine at position 8 in tRNA (s⁴U8)** and sulfur transfer to **ThiS**, producing ThiS thiocarboxylate for thiazole synthesis in **thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis**. The sulfur donor is annotated as IscS persulfide. Homolog annotations also place ThiI in the cytoplasm.

The homologs contain a **THUMP domain** and a C-terminal **rhodanese domain**. A persulfide-intermediate cysteine is annotated at homolog position 457; that position has not been independently mapped onto this query sequence.

**Sequence-derived properties:** length 485 aa; predicted molecular mass **54.9 kDa**; theoretical pI **5.74**. These are computational estimates for the unmodified sequence.
